what: The registration described CCMT backgrounds as plain studio backgrounds. Inspection showed a mix of leaves on paper or card and field photographs, and leaves that fill the frame. The first segmentation method (border colour, records/nb08) rejected 1,409 of 1,702 images; it was replaced by a saturation-based prior with GrabCut (records/nb08_v2) before any H2 endpoint was read.
remedy: H2 is run on the CCMT images whose background is paper or card: 1000 of 1702 selected images ({"leaf_fraction_out_of_range": 486, "background_not_plain": 214, "no_foreground_seed": 2} excluded). Excluded images are counted per class in e12_segmentation_summary.json. Design, conditions and endpoints are as registered; the H2 result applies to paper-background images and is reported as such.

what: The registration planned the LiteRT benchmark_model binary over USB on a personally owned Android phone. The on-device measurement was made instead on real Android phones hosted by Qualcomm AI Hub (Samsung Galaxy S24 (Family), Google Pixel 3), CPU only, LiteRT runtime, 1 and 4 threads where the service accepted the option.
remedy: Device names and attributes are recorded in records/nb12/devices.json and every raw profile is kept. Latency and memory are reported as hosted-phone measurements; the offline laptop benchmark is unchanged. No accuracy figure depends on this change.
